name: MduBuildingAccessManager
tagline: Landlord consent to live units for every apartment block – in one Power Platform control.
description: Complete multi-dwelling-unit rollout app for fibre and broadband operators: landlord consent with chases and expiry, site surveys, in-building wiring and build partners, a floor stack of units passed and live, take-up, a pipeline board with stage rules and a rollout plan by target RFS month. Works in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Stage gates: consent granted before survey, survey passed before design/build, RFS threshold of units passed
Landlord consent workflow with chase interval, grant with expiry, refusal and renewal
Floor-by-floor units passed / live and take-up target
Drag and drop board with rule feedback and Move… menu
Bulk move, owner, chase and CSV export with undo
Demo mode, map-your-columns and read-only states
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control)
